notes.title: Halloween Update 🎃
notes.content:
[h3]🍬 Trick or treat! 👻[/h3]

Here's the [b]Halloween Update[/b] of Tidy Cauldron! This free update comes with [b]15 new levels[/b] with a new background and music, 4 new animated ingredients, and 4 new achievements. All Halloween-themed 🧛 You can play these levels at any time, they are independent from the 100 levels of the base game.

This update comes with some [b]Quality-of-Life upgrades[/b].

[previewyoutube=eoolem7Tne4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🛠️ QoL and improvements 🛠️[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now either hold the left mouse button or click to pick up an ingredient.
[*] You can quickly remove an ingredient from the grid by right-clicking on it.
[*] Icons added on bookmarks on the level selection screen, corresponding to each chapter.
[*] Fixes on UI (background images, positions on screen, and transitions).
[*] Fix missing sound when putting an ingredient back down.
[*] Fixes on the Japanese localization.
[*] Ingredients now fit on the SteamDeck screen on all levels.
[/list]
Steam Cloud save is coming shortly. We're now working on properly making Tidy Cauldron compatible with SteamDeck and looking into making a Mac version. Widescreen resolutions will come soon.

As Halloween is our favorite period of the year, this free update comes with a [b]20%[/b] discount on the game during all Steam Scream Fest. We also added [b]temporary Halloween decorations[/b] in the game to celebrate this spooky event.

Don't hesitate to report any bugs or suggestions you may have in the Steam discussions if you encounter any issues!

Please consider leaving a review if you enjoy our game! It helps us greatly with visibility 🫰

Have a spooky good time tidying!
Flo and Cléo from Purring Campfire 🏕️

notes.title: Japanese, Russian and Simplified Chinese Localization!
notes.content:
Tidy Cauldron is now available in [b]3 new languages[/b]!
[list][*] Japanese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Russian
[/list]
Thanks to LocQuest for the localization and to the translators: Yuri Tanaka and M. Azuma for the Japanese localization, Hannah Lu and Albert Wei for the Simplified Chinese one, and Oleg Pelipejchenko and Dmitry Kornyukhov for the Russian one.

Please let us know if you encounter any bugs or typos while playing in those new languages. 
Consider leaving a review if you enjoy our game, it helps us a lot with visibility. 🫰

Have fun tidying!
Flo and Cléo from Purring Campfire 🏕️

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese localization and first patch! 💫
notes.content:
Olá! 🌞

We're glad to announce that Tidy Cauldron is now fully translated into [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b] thanks to the amazing Thiago Mania!

This update comes with our [b]first patch[/b] fixing minor bugs. 🛠️

Don't hesitate to report any bug or suggestion you may have on the Steam discussions if you encounter any issues!

Please consider leaving a review if you enjoy our game, it helps small teams like us greatly with visibility. 🫰

[h3]Patch notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Achievements related to the skip feature can now be unlocked after the game is complete by skipping any levels.
[*] Bugfix achievements "A witch is born", "Broomance", and "Clean Freak" now unlock properly. For players who should have unlocked them and encountered issues, it will be fixed the next time you launch the game: all the missing achievements will be unlocked automatically on the home screen.
[*] Bugfix achievement "66...6?" now unlocks properly when level 66 is complete.
[*] Bugfix buttons disappearing on the Credits screen.
[/list]
Happy tidying!
Flo and Cléo from Purring Campfire 🏕️

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
A few minor fixes:
- Fix rotation of ingredient "Green Toad" on level 22 
- Slight change of ingredients position on all levels so they are not behind the menu interface 
- Security added if an ingredient rotation is not valid, it will be fixed when dropping the ingredient so the level can be continued
